title: Little Hawley Rising Anew
author: A. M. Zhou
blurb: Ada Winterbourne, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
